fields.name: ShardDataConnection<TConfiguration> QueryAsync family
fields.contract: For a Query contract, QueryAsync returns a TModel instance produced entirely by a caller-supplied QueryResultModelHandler delegate from the query's output parameters and data reader, not by a built-in reader-to-model mapping convention. Variants select: whether an optional TArg argument is threaded through to the handler (QueryResultModelHandler<TArg,TModel> plus an optionalArgument parameter passed to it) or omitted (QueryResultModelHandler<object,TModel>, with null passed in the unused argument slot since there is no caller-supplied TArg value); and whether a named parameter is bound to the endpoint's current shard identifier before execution. There is no reader-result-type dimension on this family -- that belongs to the MapReaderAsync/MapOutputAsync families, which supply their own built-in handlers.
